item.title: Karpaga Vinayaga College of Engineering and Technology
item.description: Karpaga Vinayaga College of Engineering and Technology was established in the year 2001, Approved by AICTE, New Delhi, and Affiliated to Anna University, Chennai. KVEG campus away from the hustle and bustle of the city but in close proximity to the scene. The Campus hosts Dedicated and well-qualified faculty members, well-planned lecture halls, computer centers, libraries, laboratories, Auditorium, and above all the quality education are provided to cater to the needs of this competitive field.
